visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with short brown hair, wearing a dark green velvet long-sleeved shirt and patterned pants, sits on the floor in front of a decorated Christmas tree. She holds a large white box featuring a 'Crybaby' illustration, smiling and speaking directly to the camera. (2) She uses a yellow utility knife to cut through the tape on the top of the box. She rotates the box to show the back and sides, which contain technical specifications and illustrations. She then pulls a plastic tray containing a large figure out of the box. (3) She removes a brown-skinned 'Crybaby' figure with white teardrop markings from its plastic packaging. She begins to dress the figure, first with a white and red undergarment, then a large red velvet cape with white fur trim, and finally places a large golden crown on its head. (4) The fully dressed figure is shown sitting on the floor in front of the box and the Christmas tree, which is lit and decorated with blue, silver, and gold ornaments.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A female voice speaks with high energy and a bright, excited tone, saying "Tada!" followed by an unboxing introduction. The background music is an upbeat pop-electronic track with a steady 4/4 beat. (2) A distinct, sharp metallic 'click' sound is heard as a blade opens the box, immediately followed by high-frequency rustling of plastic wrapping. The music continues consistently in the background. (3) The female voice exclaims "So cute!" with high pitch variability. Subdued rustling of fabric and soft thuds are heard as she dresses the figure. (4) The vocals stop, and the upbeat background music takes center stage with a clear, rhythmic ending as the final product is showcased visually.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to enthusiastically showcase the unboxing and assembly of a large Pop Mart 'Crybaby' collectible figure to engage collectors and fans of the brand during the holiday season.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The creator specifically names the product and brand (Pop Mart) and provides a detailed showcase of the figure and its packaging.
